name: Voyager Gods
slug: Gods from other pantheons who did not originate in Atlas.
description: Vecna's term for gods who did not originate in Atlas. He says they came from other pantheons, brought by other creatures, and he sets himself apart from them as Atlas-born.

log.summary: Vecna uses Voyager gods for gods who did not originate in Atlas. He says they came from other pantheons, brought by other creatures, and he sets himself apart from them as Atlas-born, calling himself a demigod rather than an elder.
